# Leaf spring bushings and clips

## Summary

Disconnect front leaf mount by undoing U-bolts and forward bolts while leaving shock absorber and rear shackle bolts attached. [t560]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Disconnect the front leaf mount by undoing the U-bolts and forward bolts.
2. [Partial] Leave the shock absorber and rear shackle bolts attached to minimize removal work.

_Procedure reported by [t560]._
